changes.after: Shield yourself, absorbing ? damage and increasing your Frost damage by 15% for 1 min. While shielded, your Frost damage is increased by an additional 5% and you do not lose casting time when you take damage.

changes.name: Ice Lance
changes.before: Deals 28 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 200% increased damage to Frozen targets.
changes.after: Deals 28 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets.

changes.name: Winter's Chill
changes.before: Gives your Frostbolt, Frost Blast, and Fingers of Frost empowered Ice Lance spells a 100% chance to apply Winter's Chill, increasing the target's damage taken from your next Cone of Cold by 5% and it gains an additional 7% of your spell damage, stacking up to 5 times.
changes.after: Gives your Frostbolt, Frost Blast, and Fingers of Frost empowered Ice Lance spells a 100% chance to apply Winter's Chill, increasing the target's damage taken from your next Cone of Cold by 20% and it gains an additional 7% of your spell damage, stacking up to 5 times.

changes.name: Anticipation
changes.before: Increases your Defense Skill by 20.
changes.after: Increases your Defense Skill by 20.

changes.name: Boundless Light
changes.after: Increases the critical strike chance of your Holy Shock spell by 30% when cast on allies not affected by your Oath of Light.

changes.name: Champion of the Light
changes.before: Increases your spell damage by up to 60% of your Intellect.
changes.after: Increases your spell damage by up to 60% of your Intellect, and reduces the cast time of your Hammer of Wrath by 1.0 sec.

changes.name: Consecrated Ground
changes.before: Gives your Holy spells 10% increased damage against the first 4 enemies that enter your Consecration.
changes.after: Gives your Holy spells 10% increased damage against the first 4 enemies that enter your Consecration.

changes.name: Conviction
changes.before: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by 5%.
changes.after: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by 6%.

changes.name: Divine Favor
changes.before: When activated, gives your next Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock spell a 100% critical effect chance.
changes.after: When activated, gives your next Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock spell a 100% critical effect chance.

changes.name: Divine Intellect
changes.before: Increases your total Intellect by 10%.
changes.after: Increases your total Intellect by 10%.

changes.name: Divine Precision
changes.before: Improves your chance to hit with Holy spells by 18%.
changes.after: Improves your chance to hit with Holy spells by 8%, and reduces the duration of Silence effects on you by 20%.

changes.name: Divine Strength
changes.after: Increases your Strength by 10%.

changes.name: Holy Conduit
changes.before: Reduces the mana cost of your Consecration, Holy Wrath, Exorcism, and Hammer of Wrath spells by 40%.
changes.after: Reduces the mana cost of your Consecration, Holy Wrath, Exorcism, and Hammer of Wrath spells by 40%.

changes.name: Holy Power
changes.before: Increases the critical strike chance of your Holy Shock and Holy Strike spells by 15%, and all other spells by 5%.
changes.after: Increases the critical strike healing bonus of your Holy spells by 50%.

changes.name: Holy Shield
changes.before: Increases chance to block by 30% for 10 sec, and deals 110 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active. Damage caused by Holy Shield causes 20% additional threat. Each block expends a charge. 4 charges.
changes.after: Increases chance to block by 30% for 10 sec, and deals 75 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active. Damage caused by Holy Shield causes 20% additional threat. Each block expends a charge. 4 charges.

changes.name: Illumination
changes.before: After getting a critical effect from your Flash of Light, Holy Light, Light's Vigil, or Holy Shock heal spell you have a 100% chance to gain Mana equal to 50% of the base cost of the spell.
changes.after: After getting a critical effect from your Flash of Light, Holy Light, Light's Vigil, or Holy Shock heal spell you have a 100% chance to gain Mana equal to 50% of the base cost of the spell.

changes.name: Improved Hammer of Justice
changes.before: Decreases the cooldown of your Hammer of Justice spell by 15 sec.
changes.after: Decreases the cooldown of your Hammer of Justice spell by 15 sec.

changes.name: Improved Righteous Fury
changes.before: While Righteous Fury is active, all damage taken is reduced by 6%.
changes.after: While Righteous Fury is active, all damage taken is reduced by 9%.

changes.name: Improved Seals
changes.before: Increases the damage done by your Seals and Judgements by 15%.
changes.after: Increases the damage done by your Seals and Judgements by 15%.

changes.name: Infusion of Light
changes.before: Your Holy Shock and Flash of Light critical hits reduce the cast time of your next Holy Light cast within 15 sec by 1.0 sec.
changes.after: Your Holy Shock and Flash of Light critical hits reduce the cast time of your next Holy Light cast within 15 sec by 1.0 sec.

changes.name: Instrument of Law
changes.before: Reduces the cast time of your Hammer of Wrath by 1.0 sec, and reduces all threat you generate by 20% while Righteous Fury is not active.

changes.name: Iron Creed
changes.before: Increases the threat generated by your Holy Strike ability by 25%. While Righteous Fury is active, Holy Strike also reduces your damage taken by 10% for 6 sec.
changes.after: Increases the threat generated by your Holy Strike ability by 30%. While Righteous Fury is active, Holy Strike also reduces your damage taken by 6% for 6 sec.

changes.name: Light's Vigil
changes.before: Applies Light's Vigil to the target for 30 sec. Your next Holy Shock cast on them triggers no cooldown and causes enemy targets to suffer 182 Holy damage and refund 75% of Light's Vigil's Mana cost, or allied targets to heal their party for 324. You may only have one Light's Vigil active per party.
changes.after: Applies Light's Vigil to a friendly target for 30 sec. The caster's next Holy Shock on the target incurs no cooldown and heals the target and their party for 324. Only one Vigil per Paladin may be active in each party.

changes.name: Oath of Light
changes.before: Grants you immunity to Silence and Interrupt effects for 6 sec.
changes.after: Swear an Oath to protect target ally for 5 min, increasing the healing of your Holy Light on them by up to ?, your Flash of Light by up to ?, and your Holy Shock by up to ?. Only one Oath of Light may be sworn by the Paladin at any one time.

changes.name: One-Handed Weapon Specialization
changes.before: Increases the damage you deal with one-handed melee weapons by 10%.

changes.name: Purifying Power
changes.before: Reduces the mana cost of your Cleanse and Purify spells by 20% and reduces the cooldown of your Exorcism and Holy Wrath spells by 33%.
changes.after: Reduces the mana cost of your Cleanse and Purify spells by 20% and reduces the cooldown of your Exorcism and Holy Wrath spells by 33%.

changes.name: Redoubt
changes.before: Damaging melee attacks against you have a 10% chance to increase your chance to block by 20%. Lasts 10 sec or 5 blocks.
changes.after: Damaging melee attacks against you have a 10% chance to increase your chance to block by 30%. Lasts 10 sec or 5 blocks.

changes.name: Repentance
changes.before: Puts the enemy target in a state of meditation, incapacitating them for up to 6 sec. Any damage caused will awaken the target. Only works against Humanoids.
changes.after: Puts the enemy target in a state of meditation, incapacitating them for up to 6 sec. Any damage caused will awaken the target. Only works against Humanoids.

changes.name: Reverence
changes.before: Allows 30% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.
changes.after: Allows 30% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

changes.name: Sacred Arbiter
changes.before: Increases the damage of your Holy Strike ability by 20% and causes it to refresh all Judgement effects on the target.
changes.after: Increases the damage of your Holy Strike ability by 20% and causes it to refresh all Judgement effects on the target.

changes.name: Sacred Duty
changes.before: Increases your total Stamina by 4% and reduces the cooldown of your Divine Shield, Divine Protection, and Templar's Bulwark spells by 60 sec.
changes.after: Reduces the cooldown of your Divine Shield, Divine Protection, and Templar's Bulwark spells by 60 sec, and reduces the duration of Forbearance by 10 sec.

changes.name: Sanctified Judgement
changes.before: Gives your Judgement ability a 100% chance to return 60% of the Mana cost of the judged seal.
changes.after: Gives your Judgement ability a 100% chance to return 60% of the Mana cost of the judged seal.

changes.name: Shield Specialization
changes.before: Increases the amount of damage absorbed by your shield by 30%, and gives your blocks a 100% chance to restore 4% of your maximum Mana. May only occur once every 3 sec.
changes.after: Increases the amount of damage absorbed by your shield by 30%, and gives your blocks a 100% chance to restore 4% of your maximum Mana. May only occur once every 3 sec.

changes.name: Shieldsworn
changes.before: When Seal of Fury's shield is fully absorbed, restore ? Mana, increased by 15% per level the attacker is above you, up to 45%.
changes.after: Reduces the cooldown of your Holy Strike ability by 4 sec. Additionally, Holy Strike now strikes with your shield, triggering your active Holy Shield and Shield Specialization talents without consuming their charges or triggering their cooldowns, and allowing you to Block spells for 6 sec.

changes.name: Spiritual Focus
changes.before: Gives your Flash of Light, Holy Light, and Light's Vigil spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.
changes.after: Gives your Flash of Light, Holy Light, and Light's Vigil spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

changes.name: Stoicism
changes.before: Increases your Strength by 10%.
changes.after: Reduces the duration of Stun and Charm effects on you by 20%.

changes.name: Swift Judgement
changes.before: Finishes the remaining cooldown on your Judgement ability and reduces the Mana cost of your next Judgement by 100%.
changes.after: Unleash the energy of a Seal spell upon an enemy. Does not consume the Seal. Refer to individual Seals for Judgement effect. Does not share a cooldown with your Judgement ability.

changes.name: Templar's Bulwark
changes.before: When activated, this ability grants you an absorb shield equal to 100% of your maximum health for 8 sec. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.
changes.after: When activated, this ability grants you an absorb shield equal to 100% of your maximum health for 8 sec. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.

changes.name: Toughness
changes.before: Increases your armor value from items by 10%.
changes.after: Increases your armor value from items by 10%.

changes.name: Turn Evil
changes.after: Reduces the cast time of your Turn Undead spell by 1.0 sec, its cooldown by 10 sec, and allows it to affect Demons.

changes.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
changes.before: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 6%.
changes.after: Increases the physical damage you deal by 6%, and reduces all threat you generate by 20% while a two-handed melee weapon is equipped.

changes.name: Unsealed Wrath
changes.before: Reduces the Mana cost of your Seal spells by 20%, and when you replace your Seal of Command, Seal of Righteousness, Seal of Fury, or Seal of Justice with a different Seal, you gain an Echo of that Seal. Your next melee attack applies the replaced Seal's effects, consuming the Echo.
changes.after: Your melee attacks store a copy of your active Seal for 15 sec, stacking up to 3 times. Landing an attack with a different Seal consumes all stacks, giving the stored Seal its normal chance to activate once per stack.

changes.name: Unyielding Faith
changes.before: Reduces the duration of Fear and Disorient effects on you by 30%.
changes.after: Reduces the duration of Fear and Disorient effects on you by 30%.

changes.name: Vengeance
changes.before: Increases your Physical and Holy damage dealt by 3% for 30 sec after landing a non-periodic critical strike. Stacks up to 3 times.
changes.after: Increases your Physical and Holy damage dealt by 3% for 30 sec after landing a non-periodic critical strike. Stacks up to 3 times.

changes.name: Vindication
changes.before: Gives your damaging melee attacks a chance to reduce the target's Attack Power by -6, and increase your Attack Power by 3% for 30 sec.
changes.after: Gives your damaging melee attacks a chance to reduce the target's Attack Power by -6 for 30 sec.

changes.name: Holy Binding
changes.before: Heals a friendly target and the caster for 247. Low threat.
changes.after: Each time you heal a target other than yourself with Flash Heal, you are healed for 50% as much. This healing generates no threat.

changes.name: Renewed Hope
changes.before: Your heals from Flash Heal, Binding Heal, Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, and Penance gain 10% increased critical strike chance when cast on targets with Weakened Soul, and reduce the remaining duration of Weakened Soul on their target by 5 sec.
changes.after: Your heals from Flash Heal, Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, and Penance gain 10% increased critical strike chance when cast on targets with Weakened Soul, and reduce the remaining duration of Weakened Soul on their target by 5 sec.

changes.name: Improved Drains
changes.before: Increases health drained or damage done by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells by 20%.
changes.after: Increases Health drained, damage done, or Mana drained by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Drain Mana spells by 20%.
